System architecture

One evidence chain, from packet to patch.

Every stage preserves the incident context needed by the next. Automated fixes are staged for review, never silently merged.

01

Detect

Falco captures execve, openat, and connect events.

eBPF · Kubernetes
02

Correlate

Python AST walkers resolve the syscall to an exact source sink and function.

File · Line · Function
03

Verify

A synthesized Semgrep taint rule confirms whether untrusted input reaches the sink.

CWE · OWASP · Taint
04

Remediate

A unified diff replaces the dangerous call with a validated, parameterized alternative.

Review-ready patch
05

Observe

Elasticsearch and Kibana retain the verdict, origin, and forensic trail.
